hero.title: Our Team
hero.subtitle: Meet the leaders dedicated to providing trauma-informed care and guiding our community toward a brighter future.

jeanette.title: Clinical Director
jeanette.bio: With over 20 years of dedicated experience in child welfare, Jeanette is a leading psychotherapist specializing in trauma-informed care, family preservation, and attachment-based interventions.

marissa.title: Director of Operations
marissa.bio: Marissa oversees the daily operations of our programs, ensuring efficient delivery of services and a seamless experience for the communities we serve.

shing.title: Wraparound Manager
shing.bio: Shing brings extensive experience in care coordination, guiding our facilitators to build strong, supportive networks around families.

mikalah.title: Executive Director
mikalah.bio: With over 25 years in education and social work, Dr. Williams integrates neuroscience and trauma-informed practices to build therapeutic wellness spaces, guiding families from reactive survival to grounded neurological regulation.
